bull.t: Broader Customer Adoption And GPO Access
bull.b: Increasing multi-product adoption can deepen customer relationships and raise revenue per account, while GPO access expands procurement reach through established channels. Together, these developments may support more repeatable hospital demand and improve the company’s commercial position over the next several quarters.

If executed, lower operating expenses and internal production could reduce cash losses and improve gross margins from the current mid-50s toward management’s stated longer-term target. These initiatives address both operating leverage and product economics, potentially strengthening the business model beyond temporary revenue changes.

bull.t: Improved Revenue Outlook And Hospital Momentum
bull.b: A higher revenue outlook alongside sequential hospital growth indicates that the company is seeing commercial traction in a strategically important channel. Continued hospital expansion could provide a more durable demand base, particularly as internal systems, GPO access and sales productivity become fully operational.

bear.b: The sharply reduced cash balance and accelerating operating cash use leave limited room to absorb execution setbacks or fund planned growth internally. This makes near-term financing and cash-runway management critical, and could constrain strategic flexibility while the company works toward lower expenses.

Widening net and adjusted EBITDA losses show that current revenue is not yet supporting the company’s cost base. Persistent losses weaken cash generation, increase dependence on financing or operational improvements, and make the planned return toward profitability highly dependent on successful execution.

bear.t: Gross Margin Compression Before Technology Transfer
bear.b: Lower gross margins reduce the contribution available to cover operating expenses and prolong the path to breakeven. Because management expects pressure to continue until technology transfer is completed, margin recovery remains execution-dependent over the next several quarters rather than immediately available.
